title: Grade 4 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — General Assessment #19

pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is the mustard seed like in size? (1 mark)
   A. As big as an egg
   B. Very small
   C. Very large
   D. Medium

2. In which Gospel passage did Jesus bless little children? (1 mark)
   A. Acts 2:1
   B. Genesis 12:1
   C. Matthew 19:13-15
   D. John 3:1

3. Why did the donkey turn away from the road? (1 mark)
   A. She saw the angel and Balaam did not
   B. She was afraid of Balak
   C. She was tired
   D. She was hungry

4. What did Jesus say a person must be born of? (1 mark)
   A. Bread and wine
   B. Fire and wind
   C. Earth and sky
   D. Water and the Spirit

5. How did Zechariah get his speech back? (1 mark)
   A. After a healing by Jesus
   B. After a long sleep
   C. After visiting Jerusalem
   D. After writing "His name is John"

6. In the reference John 3:16, what does the number 16 stand for? (1 mark)
   A. The verse
   B. The book
   C. The page
   D. The chapter

7. Which of these is a trusted person at school? (1 mark)
   A. Someone who asks for secrets
   B. A person who offers gifts
   C. A stranger at the gate
   D. Your class teacher

8. What does Psalm 122:1 say people were glad to do? (1 mark)
   A. Go to sleep
   B. Go to market
   C. Go to war
   D. Go to the house of the Lord

9. Who tried to run away from God's task? (1 mark)
   A. Daniel
   B. Joseph
   C. Jonah
   D. Stephen

10. What is eternal life? (1 mark)
   A. Life with God that never ends
   B. A kind of food
   C. Life on earth only
   D. A long holiday

11. What did John call people to do? (1 mark)
   A. Trade
   B. Fight
   C. Repent
   D. Rest

12. What did Jesus say about why He came? (1 mark)
   A. To collect taxes
   B. To seek and to save the lost
   C. To rule Rome
   D. To build a palace

13. Someone offers you sweets and asks you to keep a secret. What should you do? (1 mark)
   A. Accept and hide it
   B. Go with them
   C. Refuse and tell a trusted adult
   D. Ask for more

14. How did Jesus feel when He saw the widow? (1 mark)
   A. He was angry
   B. He was bored
   C. He was afraid
   D. His heart went out to her

15. What did Samson find later in the body of the lion? (1 mark)
   A. Nothing
   B. A snake
   C. Gold
   D. Bees and honey

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Name two ways of showing compassion to a grieving neighbour. (2 marks)

17. Explain how a child can show compassion at school and at home, and why prayer is important when facing challenges. (5 marks)

18. Describe Joseph's plan to save Egypt from the famine. (4 marks)

19. Give two examples of school property. (2 marks)

20. Name two people you can tell if you are touched in a way that makes you unsafe. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — Very small
   It is one of the smallest seeds.

2. C — Matthew 19:13-15
   Matthew 19:13-15 records it.

3. A — She saw the angel and Balaam did not
   The donkey saw what Balaam could not see.

4. D — Water and the Spirit
   John 3:5 says this.

5. D — After writing "His name is John"
   His mouth was opened when he wrote the name.

6. A — The verse
   In John 3:16, John is the book, 3 is the chapter, and 16 is the verse.

7. D — Your class teacher
   Teachers help keep children safe.

8. D — Go to the house of the Lord
   The psalm rejoices at going to God's house.

9. C — Jonah
   Jonah ran away before he obeyed.

10. A — Life with God that never ends
   Eternal life is everlasting life with God.

11. C — Repent
   John called people to turn from their sins.

12. B — To seek and to save the lost
   Luke 19:10 says that the Son of Man came to seek and save the lost.

13. C — Refuse and tell a trusted adult
   Gifts with secrets are a warning sign.

14. D — His heart went out to her
   Luke 7:13 says He had compassion.

15. D — Bees and honey
   Judges 14:8 says a swarm of bees and honey were there.

SECTION B
----
16. (2 marks)
   Answer: Visit, comfort, share food, pray with them. Any two.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way.

17. (5 marks)
   Answer: At school: share, comfort a sad classmate, include a lonely child. At home: help with chores, care for a sick family member. Prayer is important because God hears us and helps, and it gives peace and courage.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for a school example, 1 for a home example, 1 for God hearing, 1 for peace or courage, 1 for clear link to compassion.

18. (4 marks)
   Answer: Find a wise man to be in charge, take a fifth of the grain during the seven good years, store it in the towns, and use it in the famine years.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point up to 4.

19. (2 marks)
   Answer: Desks, textbooks, library books, toilets, compound.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: Parent, guardian, teacher, pastor, nurse, police officer. Any two.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid person.
